0022600089.text: Both the Memphis Grizzlies and Utah Jazz open their 2026-27 seasons with this game in Memphis. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury, and GG Jackson, Jerami Grant and Micah Peavy are day-to-day and game-time decisions, with Jackson and Peavy listed for ankle issues and Grant for undisclosed soreness. Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic, who is out with a foot injury, and Blake Hinson, Kyle Filipowski and Trey Alexander are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while the teams split their four meetings in 2025-26 at 2-2 and Utah won the most recent one 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Memphis a 45% chance to win.
